task.description: Design fix artefact for ISS-0601-RECON-LEAK memory leaks. Create src/design/reconstruction-leak-fix.md documenting the fix approach: (1) duplicate ObjectMap keys before put() in parseObjectMapFromJson and cloneJsonValue, (2) implement freeObjectMap() helper, (3) update freeJsonValue() to free object keys, (4) replace test map.deinit() calls. This is Type E (novel/cross-cutting) per lego-catalog. No implementation code - design only.
acceptance_criteria: Documents key duplication pattern for ObjectMap
Documents freeObjectMap() helper function signature and behavior

result.summary: Design for reconstruction memory leak fix — Type E (novel/cross-cutting). Documents key duplication pattern, freeObjectMap() helper, freeJsonValue() changes, test cleanup pattern, and why arena allocator approach failed.
